445	    user_requests     : Training set of UserRequest objects.
446	    config            : Full training configuration (n_envs, PPO hyperparams, paths).
447	    env_config        : Environment configuration (max token dims).
448	    reward_config     : Reward component weights.
449	    tokenizer         : HF tokenizer (or None to use char-level fallback in CompressionEnv).
450	    tensorboard_log   : Directory for TensorBoard logs. Defaults to ``outputs/logs``.
451	    checkpoint_dir    : Directory for SB3 + compressor checkpoints. Defaults to ``outputs/checkpoints``.
452	    training_log_dir  : Root directory for training-only JSONL artifacts (PPO update metrics,
453	                        episode summaries). Each ``train()`` call creates a timestamped
454	                        subdirectory under this path. Defaults to ``outputs/training``.
455	    reward_predictor  : Optional RewardPredictorComponent. When provided, a
456	                        RewardPredictorCallback is added to the callback list so
457	                        that a PyTorch linear model trains on episode rewards.
458	    reward_predictor_fit_every : How often (in episodes) the callback triggers fit().
459	    """
460	
461	    def __init__(
462	        self,
463	        compressor: TrainableCompressorBase,
464	        agent_factory: Callable,
465	        simulator_factory: Callable[[int], SimulatorProtocol],
466	        user_requests: list[UserRequest],
467	        config: TrainingConfig | None = None,
468	        env_config: EnvConfig | None = None,
469	        reward_config: RewardConfig | None = None,
470	        simulator_config: SimulatorConfig | None = None,
471	        tokenizer: Any = None,
472	        tensorboard_log: str | Path = "outputs/logs",
473	        checkpoint_dir: str | Path = "outputs/checkpoints",
474	        training_log_dir: str | Path = "outputs/training",
475	        reward_predictor: Any = None,
476	        reward_predictor_fit_every: int = 50,
477	    ) -> None:
478	        self._compressor = compressor
479	        self._agent_factory = agent_factory
480	        self._simulator_factory = simulator_factory
481	        self._user_requests = user_requests
482	        self._config = config or TrainingConfig()
483	        self._env_config = env_config or EnvConfig()
484	        self._reward_config = reward_config or RewardConfig()
485	        self._simulator_config = simulator_config or SimulatorConfig()
486	        self._tokenizer = tokenizer
487	        self._tensorboard_log = Path(tensorboard_log)
488	        self._checkpoint_dir = Path(checkpoint_dir)
489	        self._training_log_dir = Path(training_log_dir)
490	        self._reward_predictor = reward_predictor
491	        self._reward_predictor_fit_every = reward_predictor_fit_every
492	
493	        self._ppo: PPO | None = None
494	        self._device = self._resolve_device(self._config.device)
495	        log.info("trainer.device", device=self._device)
496	
497	    @staticmethod
498	    def _resolve_device(device_cfg: str) -> str:
499	        """Resolve 'auto' to 'cuda' or 'cpu' based on availability."""
500	        if device_cfg == "auto":
501	            return "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
502	        return device_cfg
503	
504	    # ── Public interface ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
505	
506	    def train(self, num_timesteps: int | None = None) -> None:
507	        """
508	        Run PPO training for ``num_timesteps`` environment steps.
509	
510	        If ``config.resume_from`` is set, the SB3 model is loaded from that
511	        checkpoint before continuing. Compressor weights are loaded separately
512	        via ``load_checkpoint()``.
513	
514	        Parameters
515	        ----------
516	        num_timesteps : Override for the number of training steps.
517	                        Defaults to ``config.num_timesteps``.
518	        """
519	        n_steps = num_timesteps or self._config.num_timesteps
520	
521	        # Create a timestamped run directory for training-only JSONL artifacts.
522	        # Each train() call gets its own directory so runs don't overwrite each other.
523	        run_id = datetime.now(tz=timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
524	        run_logger = RLRunLogger(run_id=run_id, training_dir=self._training_log_dir)
525	
526	        # Save manifest immediately so post-processing tools can find this run.
527	        run_dir = self._training_log_dir / run_id
528	        manifest = TrainingRunManifest.create(
529	            run_id=run_id,
530	            compressor_type=type(self._compressor).__name__,
531	            n_train_requests=len(self._user_requests),
532	            checkpoint_dir=self._checkpoint_dir,
533	            run_name=getattr(self._config, "run_name", "") or "",
534	            reward_weights=self._reward_config.weights.model_dump(),
535	            ppo_hyperparams=self._config.ppo.model_dump(),
536	            n_envs=self._config.n_envs,
537	            num_timesteps=n_steps,
538	            extra={"device": self._device},
539	        )
540	        save_manifest(manifest, run_dir)
541	        log.info("trainer.manifest.saved", run_id=run_id, path=str(run_dir / "manifest.json"))
542	
543	        # Build vectorised env (with WorldPool if configured)
544	        vec_env = self._make_vec_env()
545	
546	        # Build or restore PPO model and move to device
547	        if self._config.resume_from:
548	            self._ppo = self._load_ppo(self._config.resume_from, vec_env)
549	        else:
550	            self._ppo = self._build_ppo(vec_env)
551	
552	        # Explicitly move the compressor to the training device.
553	        # SB3 moves standard policy layers (token_embed, value_net) automatically,
554	        # but the compressor's HF model is a nested object that needs explicit placement.
555	        try:
556	            self._compressor.to(self._device)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
557	        except AttributeError:
558	            pass  # non-HF compressors (IdentityCompressor) may not expose .to()
559	
560	        # Build callbacks
561	        callbacks = self._build_callbacks(run_logger=run_logger)
562	
563	        # Run training
564	        try:
565	            self._ppo.learn(
566	                total_timesteps=n_steps,
567	                callback=callbacks,
568	                reset_num_timesteps=not bool(self._config.resume_from),
569	            )
570	        finally:
571	            run_logger.close()
572	
573	    def save_checkpoint(self, path: str | Path | None = None) -> None:
574	        """
575	        Save SB3 PPO model + compressor weights.
576	
577	        Parameters
578	        ----------
579	        path : Directory to save into. Defaults to ``checkpoint_dir/final``.
580	        """
581	        if self._ppo is None:
582	            raise RuntimeError("No trained model to save. Call train() first.")
583	
584	        save_dir = Path(path) if path else self._checkpoint_dir / "final"
585	        save_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
586	
587	        # SB3 saves policy + optimizer state into a single zip
588	        ppo_path = save_dir / "ppo_model"
589	        self._ppo.save(str(ppo_path))
590	
591	        # Compressor weights (HF format or custom)
592	        compressor_path = save_dir / "compressor"
593	        compressor_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
594	        self._compressor.save_checkpoint(str(compressor_path))
595	
596	    def load_checkpoint(self, path: str | Path) -> None:
597	        """
598	        Load compressor weights from a checkpoint directory.
599	
600	        Note: To resume SB3 PPO training state (optimizer, step count), call
601	        ``train()`` with ``config.resume_from`` set. This method only restores
602	        the compressor model weights.
603	
604	        Parameters
605	        ----------
606	        path : Directory containing the ``compressor/`` sub-directory.
607	        """
608	        compressor_path = Path(path) / "compressor"
609	        if not compressor_path.exists():
610	            # Allow passing the compressor directory directly
611	            compressor_path = Path(path)
612	        self._compressor.load_checkpoint(str(compressor_path))
613	
614	    # ── Private helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
615	
616	    def _make_vec_env(self) -> VecEnv:
617	        """
618	        Create a vectorised ``CompressionEnv`` using SB3's ``make_vec_env``.
619	
620	        Uses WorldPool when ``simulator_config.unique_per_episode=False`` (default)
621	        to avoid regenerating a world on every reset.  Falls back to the raw
622	        simulator_factory when unique_per_episode=True.
623	
624	        Each parallel environment gets its own ReActAgent on every reset(),
625	        so there is no shared policy state across workers.
626	        """
627	        reward_fn = RewardFunction(config=self._reward_config)
628	        env_config = self._env_config
629	        tokenizer = self._tokenizer
630	        agent_factory = self._agent_factory
631	        user_requests = self._user_requests
632	
633	        # Choose simulator source: pool or fresh-per-episode
634	        if self._simulator_config.unique_per_episode:
635	            effective_factory = self._simulator_factory
636	        else:
637	            pool = WorldPool(
638	                simulator_factory=self._simulator_factory,
639	                pool_size=self._simulator_config.pool_size,
640	                seed_range=tuple(self._simulator_config.seed_range),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
641	                rng_seed=getattr(self._config, "seed", 42),
642	            )
643	            pool.build()
644	            log.info("world_pool.ready", pool_size=len(pool))
645	            effective_factory = pool.sample
646	
647	        def env_factory() -> CompressionEnv:
648	            return CompressionEnv(
649	                agent_factory=agent_factory,
650	                simulator_factory=effective_factory,
651	                reward_fn=reward_fn,
652	                user_requests=user_requests,
653	                config=env_config,
654	                tokenizer=tokenizer,
655	            )
656	
657	        vec_env = make_vec_env(
658	            env_factory,
659	            n_envs=self._config.n_envs,
660	            seed=getattr(self._config, "seed", None),
661	        )
662	        return vec_env
663	
664	    @staticmethod
665	    def _make_lr_schedule(base_lr: float, schedule: str, num_timesteps: int) -> Any:
666	        """
667	        Build an SB3-compatible learning rate schedule callable.
668	
669	        Parameters
670	        ----------
671	        base_lr        : Starting learning rate.
672	        schedule       : 'constant' | 'linear' | 'cosine'
673	        num_timesteps  : Total training steps (used for decay schedules).
674	
675	        Returns
676	        -------
677	        Callable(progress_remaining: float) → float
678	            SB3 passes ``progress_remaining`` which goes from 1.0 → 0.0.
679	        """
680	        import math as _math
681	
682	        if schedule == "linear":
683	            def lr_fn(progress_remaining: float) -> float:
684	                # Decays from base_lr to base_lr/10 as progress goes 1.0 → 0.0
685	                return base_lr * (0.1 + 0.9 * progress_remaining)
686	            return lr_fn
687	
688	        if schedule == "cosine":
689	            def lr_fn(progress_remaining: float) -> float:
690	                # Cosine annealing from base_lr to base_lr/10
691	                cos_val = (1.0 + _math.cos(_math.pi * (1.0 - progress_remaining))) / 2.0
692	                return base_lr * (0.1 + 0.9 * cos_val)
693	            return lr_fn
694	
695	        # Default: constant
696	        return base_lr
697	
698	    def _build_ppo(self, vec_env: VecEnv) -> PPO:
699	        """
700	        Instantiate SB3 PPO with ``CompressorPolicy``.
701	
702	        ``policy_kwargs`` are forwarded to ``CompressorPolicy.__init__()``
703	        as additional keyword arguments beyond what SB3 injects automatically
704	        (observation_space, action_space, lr_schedule).
705	        """
706	        hp: PPOHyperparams = self._config.ppo
707	
708	        lr_schedule = self._make_lr_schedule(
709	            base_lr=hp.learning_rate,
710	            schedule=getattr(hp, "lr_schedule", "constant"),
711	            num_timesteps=self._config.num_timesteps,
712	        )
713	
714	        policy_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {
715	            "compressor": self._compressor,
716	            "value_hidden_dim": 256,
717	        }
718	
719	        ppo = PPO(
720	            policy=CompressorPolicy,
721	            env=vec_env,
722	            learning_rate=lr_schedule,
723	            n_steps=hp.n_steps,
724	            batch_size=hp.batch_size,
725	            n_epochs=hp.n_epochs,
726	            gamma=hp.gamma,
727	            gae_lambda=hp.gae_lambda,
728	            clip_range=hp.clip_epsilon,
729	            ent_coef=hp.ent_coef,
730	            vf_coef=hp.vf_coef,
731	            max_grad_norm=hp.max_grad_norm,
732	            tensorboard_log=str(self._tensorboard_log),
733	            policy_kwargs=policy_kwargs,
734	            device=self._device,
735	            verbose=1,
736	        )
737	        return ppo
738	
739	    def _load_ppo(self, checkpoint_path: str | Path, vec_env: VecEnv) -> PPO:
740	        """
741	        Load SB3 PPO from a checkpoint zip and set the new vec_env.
742	
743	        The compressor weights inside the policy are NOT automatically restored
744	        by SB3 — ``load_checkpoint()`` must be called separately.
745	        """
746	        ppo_zip = Path(checkpoint_path) / "ppo_model.zip"
747	        if not ppo_zip.exists():
748	            ppo_zip = Path(checkpoint_path)  # allow passing the zip directly
749	
750	        policy_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {
751	            "compressor": self._compressor,
752	            "value_hidden_dim": 256,
753	        }
754	
755	        ppo = PPO.load(
756	            str(ppo_zip),
757	            env=vec_env,
758	            policy_kwargs=policy_kwargs,
759	        )
760	        return ppo
761	
762	    def _build_callbacks(self, run_logger: "RLRunLogger") -> CallbackList:
763	        """
764	        Build the list of SB3 callbacks used during ``ppo.learn()``.
765	
766	        Includes:
767	        - SB3 built-in ``CheckpointCallback`` — saves full PPO model as zip.
768	        - ``CompressorCheckpointCallback`` — saves only the compressor weights.
769	        - ``EpisodeLogCallback`` — reward components, episode stats → TensorBoard + JSONL.
770	        - ``PPOUpdateMetricsCallback`` — per-update PPO diagnostics → TensorBoard + JSONL.
771	        - ``MCTSMetricsCallback`` — MCTS tree stats → TensorBoard (no-op for non-MCTS runs).
772	
773	        Parameters
774	        ----------
775	        run_logger : Active ``RLRunLogger`` for this training run.
776	        """
777	        self._checkpoint_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
778	        self._tensorboard_log.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
779	
780	        checkpoint_every = getattr(self._config, "checkpoint_every_n_steps", 10_000)
781	
782	        sb3_ckpt = CheckpointCallback(
783	            save_freq=checkpoint_every,
784	            save_path=str(self._checkpoint_dir),
785	            name_prefix="ppo_compressor",
786	            verbose=1,
787	        )
788	
789	        compressor_ckpt = CompressorCheckpointCallback(
790	            compressor=self._compressor,
791	            save_dir=self._checkpoint_dir,
792	            save_every_n_steps=checkpoint_every,
793	            verbose=1,
794	        )
795	
796	        episode_log_cb = EpisodeLogCallback(
797	            run_logger=run_logger,
798	            episode_save_freq=getattr(self._config, "episode_save_freq", 0),
799	            episodes_dir=Path(self._tensorboard_log).parent / "episodes",
800	            verbose=0,
801	        )
802	        ppo_metrics_cb = PPOUpdateMetricsCallback(run_logger=run_logger, verbose=0)
803	        mcts_metrics = MCTSMetricsCallback(verbose=0)  # no-op for non-MCTS runs
804	
805	        callbacks: list[BaseCallback] = [
806	            sb3_ckpt,
807	            compressor_ckpt,
808	            episode_log_cb,
809	            ppo_metrics_cb,
810	            mcts_metrics,
811	        ]
812	
813	        if self._reward_predictor is not None:
814	            rp_cb = RewardPredictorCallback(
815	                reward_predictor=self._reward_predictor,
816	                fit_every_n_episodes=self._reward_predictor_fit_every,
817	                verbose=1,
818	            )
819	            callbacks.append(rp_cb)
820	
821	        return CallbackList(callbacks)

"""
training/trainer.py
====================
RLTrainer — wires SB3 PPO + custom CompressorPolicy + CompressionEnv.

Responsibilities
----------------
1. Build ``CompressionEnv`` (vectorised via ``make_vec_env``).
2. Instantiate SB3 ``PPO`` with ``CompressorPolicy`` as the policy class.
3. Attach TensorBoard + custom callbacks for episode logging and checkpointing.
4. Expose ``train()``, ``save_checkpoint()``, ``load_checkpoint()``.

Why a thin wrapper instead of calling SB3 directly?
----------------------------------------------------
- Encapsulates the tedious ``policy_kwargs`` plumbing (passing the compressor
  and value_hidden_dim into CompressorPolicy.__init__).
- Provides a single place for project-specific callbacks (episode-level reward
  logging, compressed-state quality metrics).
- Makes checkpoint/resume logic reusable from ``scripts/run_training.py``.

SB3 version note
----------------
This code targets ``stable-baselines3 >= 2.3``. The ``PPO`` constructor
accepts ``policy_kwargs`` which are forwarded to the policy ``__init__``.
Custom policies must be passed as a class (not an instance).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
from collections import deque
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable

import numpy as np
import torch
from stable_baselines3 import PPO
from stable_baselines3.common.callbacks import (
    BaseCallback,
    CallbackList,
    CheckpointCallback,
)
from stable_baselines3.common.env_util import make_vec_env
from stable_baselines3.common.vec_env import VecEnv

from optimized_llm_planning_memory.compressor.trainable_base import TrainableCompressorBase
from optimized_llm_planning_memory.core.config import EnvConfig, PPOHyperparams, RewardConfig, SimulatorConfig, TrainingConfig
from optimized_llm_planning_memory.core.models import UserRequest
from optimized_llm_planning_memory.simulator.protocol import SimulatorProtocol
from optimized_llm_planning_memory.simulator.world_pool import WorldPool
from optimized_llm_planning_memory.training.env import CompressionEnv
from optimized_llm_planning_memory.training.policy import CompressorPolicy
from optimized_llm_planning_memory.training.reward import RewardFunction
from optimized_llm_planning_memory.training.run_logger import (
    EpisodeMetricsSummary,
    PPOUpdateMetrics,
    RLRunLogger,
)
from optimized_llm_planning_memory.training.run_manifest import (
    TrainingRunManifest,
    save_manifest,
)
from optimized_llm_planning_memory.utils.logging import get_logger

log = get_logger(__name__)


# ── Custom callbacks ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


class EpisodeLogCallback(BaseCallback):
    """
    SB3 callback that extracts per-episode reward components from the ``info``
    dict returned by ``CompressionEnv.step()`` and writes them to TensorBoard
    and (optionally) to the ``RLRunLogger`` JSONL store.

    Enhanced over the original to also log:
    - ``episode/total_steps`` — episode length (diagnoses over/under-planning)
    - ``episode/tool_calls_total`` — total tool invocations
    - ``episode/tool_success_rate`` — fraction of successful tool calls
    - ``episode/reward_mean_20`` — rolling mean of total reward (last 20 episodes)
    - ``episode/num_compressions`` — number of compression events in the episode

    Parameters
    ----------
    run_logger        : Optional ``RLRunLogger``.  When provided, each completed
                        episode is also written to ``episode_metrics.jsonl``.
    tb_log_prefix     : TensorBoard tag prefix.  Defaults to ``"episode"``.
    rolling_window    : Window size for the rolling reward mean.
    episode_save_freq : Save a full EpisodeLog JSON every N episodes.
                        0 = never (recommended for Colab to conserve storage).
    episodes_dir      : Directory for full EpisodeLog JSON files.
    verbose           : SB3 verbosity level.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        run_logger: "RLRunLogger | None" = None,
        tb_log_prefix: str = "episode",
        rolling_window: int = 20,
        episode_save_freq: int = 0,
        episodes_dir: str | Path = "outputs/episodes",
        verbose: int = 0,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(verbose=verbose)
        self._prefix = tb_log_prefix
        self._episode_count = 0
        self._run_logger = run_logger
        self._reward_window: deque[float] = deque(maxlen=rolling_window)
        self._episode_save_freq = episode_save_freq
        self._episodes_dir = Path(episodes_dir)

    def _on_step(self) -> bool:
        """Called after each env step. Returns True to continue training."""
        infos = self.locals.get("infos", [])
        for info in infos:
            if "reward_components" not in info:
                continue
            rc = info["reward_components"]
            episode_log = info.get("episode_log")

            # ── Reward components ──────────────────────────────────────────────
            self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/hard_constraint_score", rc.hard_constraint_score)
            self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/soft_constraint_score", rc.soft_constraint_score)
            self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/tool_efficiency_score", rc.tool_efficiency_score)
            self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/tool_failure_penalty", rc.tool_failure_penalty)
            self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/logical_consistency_score", rc.logical_consistency_score)
            self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/total_reward", rc.total_reward)
            if rc.terminal_itinerary_score is not None:
                self.logger.record(
                    f"{self._prefix}/terminal_itinerary_score",
                    rc.terminal_itinerary_score,
                )

            # ── Rolling reward mean ────────────────────────────────────────────
            self._reward_window.append(rc.total_reward)
            reward_mean = sum(self._reward_window) / len(self._reward_window)
            self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/reward_mean_20", reward_mean)

            # ── Episode-level metrics from EpisodeLog ─────────────────────────
            total_steps = 0
            tool_calls_total = 0
            tool_success_rate = 0.0
            num_compressions = 0
            request_id = info.get("request_id", "")
            agent_mode = ""

            if episode_log is not None:
                total_steps = getattr(episode_log, "total_steps", 0)
                num_compressions = len(getattr(episode_log, "compressed_states", ()))
                agent_mode = getattr(episode_log, "agent_mode", "")

                tool_stats = getattr(episode_log, "tool_stats", ())
                if tool_stats:
                    total_calls = sum(getattr(ts, "call_count", 0) for ts in tool_stats)
                    total_success = sum(getattr(ts, "success_count", 0) for ts in tool_stats)
                    tool_calls_total = total_calls
                    tool_success_rate = total_success / total_calls if total_calls > 0 else 0.0

                request_id = getattr(episode_log, "request_id", request_id)

            self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/total_steps", total_steps)
            self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/tool_calls_total", tool_calls_total)
            self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/tool_success_rate", tool_success_rate)
            self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/num_compressions", num_compressions)

            # Flush episode metrics to TensorBoard immediately rather than waiting
            # for the rollout boundary (n_steps × n_envs steps away).
            self.logger.dump(self.num_timesteps)

            # ── Persist to JSONL ───────────────────────────────────────────────
            if self._run_logger is not None:
                summary = EpisodeMetricsSummary(
                    episode_id=getattr(episode_log, "episode_id", "") if episode_log else "",
                    request_id=request_id,
                    agent_mode=agent_mode,
                    total_steps=total_steps,
                    success=getattr(episode_log, "success", False) if episode_log else False,
                    total_reward=rc.total_reward,
                    hard_constraint_score=rc.hard_constraint_score,
                    soft_constraint_score=rc.soft_constraint_score,
                    tool_efficiency_score=rc.tool_efficiency_score,
                    tool_failure_penalty=rc.tool_failure_penalty,
                    logical_consistency_score=rc.logical_consistency_score,
                    terminal_itinerary_score=rc.terminal_itinerary_score,
                    tool_calls_total=tool_calls_total,
                    tool_success_rate=tool_success_rate,
                    num_compressions=num_compressions,
                    reward_mean_20=reward_mean,
                )
                self._run_logger.log_episode_summary(summary)

            # ── Optionally persist full EpisodeLog (storage-intensive) ─────────
            if (
                self._episode_save_freq > 0
                and episode_log is not None
                and self._episode_count % self._episode_save_freq == 0
            ):
                try:
                    from optimized_llm_planning_memory.utils.episode_io import save_episode
                    self._episodes_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    save_episode(episode_log, self._episodes_dir)
                except Exception:
                    pass  # never crash training over a logging failure

            self._episode_count += 1
        return True


class CompressorCheckpointCallback(BaseCallback):
    """
    Checkpoints the compressor model (HF save_pretrained format) alongside
    the SB3 PPO zip checkpoint.

    SB3's built-in ``CheckpointCallback`` saves the full policy; this callback
    additionally saves just the compressor weights via
    ``TrainableCompressorBase.save_checkpoint()``, which is lighter-weight
    and loadable without SB3.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        compressor: TrainableCompressorBase,
        save_dir: str | Path,
        save_every_n_steps: int = 10_000,
        verbose: int = 0,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(verbose=verbose)
        self._compressor = compressor
        self._save_dir = Path(save_dir)
        self._save_every = save_every_n_steps
        self._last_saved = 0

    def _on_step(self) -> bool:
        step = self.num_timesteps
        if step - self._last_saved >= self._save_every:
            ckpt_path = self._save_dir / f"compressor_step_{step}"
            ckpt_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            self._compressor.save_checkpoint(str(ckpt_path))
            if self.verbose >= 1:
                print(f"[CompressorCheckpointCallback] Saved compressor to {ckpt_path}")
            self._last_saved = step
        return True

class RewardPredictorCallback(BaseCallback):
    """
    SB3 callback that feeds completed-episode data into a RewardPredictorComponent.

    After each step, it scans the ``infos`` list for terminated episodes.
    For each terminated episode, it extracts five scalar features from the
    ``reward_components`` dict and calls ``reward_predictor.add_episode()``.
    Every ``fit_every_n_episodes`` episodes it triggers ``reward_predictor.fit()``.

    Parameters
    ----------
    reward_predictor     : RewardPredictorComponent to update.
    fit_every_n_episodes : How often (in completed episodes) to call fit().
    verbose              : SB3 verbosity level.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        reward_predictor: Any,
        fit_every_n_episodes: int = 50,
        verbose: int = 0,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(verbose=verbose)
        self._reward_predictor = reward_predictor
        self._fit_every = fit_every_n_episodes
        self._episode_count = 0

    def _on_step(self) -> bool:
        infos = self.locals.get("infos", [])
        dones = self.locals.get("dones", [])

        for info, done in zip(infos, dones):
            if not done:
                continue
            rc = info.get("reward_components")
            if rc is None:
                continue

            # Build feature dict from RewardComponents fields
            features = {
                "hard_constraint_score": float(getattr(rc, "hard_constraint_score", 0.0)),
                "soft_constraint_score": float(getattr(rc, "soft_constraint_score", 0.0)),
                "tool_efficiency_score": float(getattr(rc, "tool_efficiency_score", 0.0)),
                "steps_per_episode": float(info.get("steps_per_episode_normalized", 0.0)),
                "budget_adherence": float(info.get("budget_adherence", 0.0)),
            }
            reward = float(getattr(rc, "total_reward", 0.0))
            self._reward_predictor.add_episode(features=features, reward=reward)
            self._episode_count += 1

            if self._episode_count % self._fit_every == 0:
                fitted = self._reward_predictor.fit()
                if self.verbose >= 1:
                    status = "OK" if fitted else "skipped (insufficient data)"
                    print(
                        f"[RewardPredictorCallback] fit() at episode "
                        f"{self._episode_count}: {status}"
                    )

        return True


class MCTSMetricsCallback(BaseCallback):
    """
    SB3 callback that logs MCTS-specific metrics to TensorBoard.

    Reads ``mcts_stats`` from the ``episode_log`` embedded in the ``info``
    dict returned by ``CompressionEnv.step()``. Silently no-ops for non-MCTS
    episodes where ``mcts_stats`` is None, so this callback is safe to attach
    unconditionally regardless of agent mode.

    TensorBoard keys written (prefixed by ``tb_log_prefix``):
      - ``mcts/nodes_explored``
      - ``mcts/max_depth_reached``
      - ``mcts/num_simulations``
      - ``mcts/root_value``
      - ``mcts/avg_branching_factor``
    """

    def __init__(self, tb_log_prefix: str = "mcts", verbose: int = 0) -> None:
        super().__init__(verbose=verbose)
        self._prefix = tb_log_prefix

    def _on_step(self) -> bool:
        infos = self.locals.get("infos", [])
        for info in infos:
            episode_log = info.get("episode_log")
            if episode_log is None:
                continue
            stats = getattr(episode_log, "mcts_stats", None)
            if stats is None:
                continue
            self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/nodes_explored", stats.nodes_explored)
            self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/max_depth_reached", stats.max_depth_reached)
            self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/num_simulations", stats.num_simulations)
            self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/root_value", stats.root_value)
            self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/avg_branching_factor", stats.avg_branching_factor)
        return True


class PPOUpdateMetricsCallback(BaseCallback):
    """
    Captures per-PPO-update diagnostics from SB3's internal logger and writes
    them to both TensorBoard and the ``RLRunLogger`` JSONL store.

    Fires on ``_on_rollout_end()``, which SB3 calls after each complete
    PPO update cycle (after the n_steps rollout has been collected and all
    n_epochs gradient steps have run).

    Why capture here instead of relying on SB3's default TensorBoard output?
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    SB3 computes ``approx_kl``, ``clip_fraction``, and ``explained_variance``
    internally but does not always expose them as standalone TensorBoard
    scalars in all versions.  This callback explicitly re-records them so they
    are always visible, and also writes them to JSONL for offline analysis
    without a running TensorBoard server.

    Parameters
    ----------
    run_logger : ``RLRunLogger`` instance for JSONL persistence.
    verbose    : SB3 verbosity level.
    """

    def __init__(self, run_logger: "RLRunLogger", verbose: int = 0) -> None:
        super().__init__(verbose=verbose)
        self._run_logger = run_logger
        self._update_count = 0

    def _on_rollout_end(self) -> None:
        """Called after each complete PPO update cycle."""
        log_values = self.model.logger.name_to_value  # type: ignore[attr-defined]

        def _get(key: str, default: float = 0.0) -> float:
            val = log_values.get(key, default)
            return float(val) if val is not None else default

        def _get_opt(key: str) -> float | None:
            val = log_values.get(key)
            return float(val) if val is not None else None

        # Advantages mean/std from SB3's rollout buffer (available after collect_rollouts)
        adv_mean: float | None = None
        adv_std: float | None = None
        try:
            rollout_buf = self.model.rollout_buffer  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
            advs = rollout_buf.advantages.flatten()
            if len(advs) > 0:
                adv_mean = float(advs.mean())
                adv_std = float(advs.std())
        except Exception:
            pass

        metrics = PPOUpdateMetrics(
            update_step=self._update_count,
            policy_loss=_get("train/policy_gradient_loss"),
            value_loss=_get("train/value_loss"),
            entropy_loss=_get("train/entropy_loss"),
            total_loss=_get("train/loss"),
            clip_fraction=_get("train/clip_fraction"),
            approx_kl=_get("train/approx_kl"),
            explained_variance=_get("train/explained_variance"),
            learning_rate=_get("train/learning_rate"),
            # grad_norm: SB3 logs this when max_grad_norm > 0
            grad_norm=_get_opt("train/grad_norm"),
            advantages_mean=adv_mean,
            advantages_std=adv_std,
            num_timesteps=self.num_timesteps,
        )

        # Ensure these appear in TensorBoard even if SB3 doesn't record them by default
        self.logger.record("train/approx_kl", metrics.approx_kl)
        self.logger.record("train/clip_fraction", metrics.clip_fraction)
        self.logger.record("train/explained_variance", metrics.explained_variance)
        if metrics.grad_norm is not None:
            self.logger.record("train/grad_norm", metrics.grad_norm)
        if adv_mean is not None:
            self.logger.record("train/advantages_mean", adv_mean)
            self.logger.record("train/advantages_std", adv_std or 0.0)

        self._run_logger.log_ppo_update(metrics)
        self._update_count += 1

    def _on_step(self) -> bool:
        return True


class RLTrainer:
    """
    Wires SB3 PPO with the custom ``CompressorPolicy`` and ``CompressionEnv``.

    Parameters
    ----------
    compressor        : Trainable compressor model (HF or custom).
    agent_factory     : Callable[[], ReActAgent] — creates a fresh agent per episode.
    simulator_factory : Callable[[int], SimulatorProtocol] — creates a fresh sim per episode.
    user_requests     : Training set of UserRequest objects.
    config            : Full training configuration (n_envs, PPO hyperparams, paths).
    env_config        : Environment configuration (max token dims).
    reward_config     : Reward component weights.
    tokenizer         : HF tokenizer (or None to use char-level fallback in CompressionEnv).
    tensorboard_log   : Directory for TensorBoard logs. Defaults to ``outputs/logs``.
    checkpoint_dir    : Directory for SB3 + compressor checkpoints. Defaults to ``outputs/checkpoints``.
    training_log_dir  : Root directory for training-only JSONL artifacts (PPO update metrics,
                        episode summaries). Each ``train()`` call creates a timestamped
                        subdirectory under this path. Defaults to ``outputs/training``.
    reward_predictor  : Optional RewardPredictorComponent. When provided, a
                        RewardPredictorCallback is added to the callback list so
                        that a PyTorch linear model trains on episode rewards.
    reward_predictor_fit_every : How often (in episodes) the callback triggers fit().
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        compressor: TrainableCompressorBase,
        agent_factory: Callable,
        simulator_factory: Callable[[int], SimulatorProtocol],
        user_requests: list[UserRequest],
        config: TrainingConfig | None = None,
        env_config: EnvConfig | None = None,
        reward_config: RewardConfig | None = None,
        simulator_config: SimulatorConfig | None = None,
        tokenizer: Any = None,
        tensorboard_log: str | Path = "outputs/logs",
        checkpoint_dir: str | Path = "outputs/checkpoints",
        training_log_dir: str | Path = "outputs/training",
        reward_predictor: Any = None,
        reward_predictor_fit_every: int = 50,
    ) -> None:
        self._compressor = compressor
        self._agent_factory = agent_factory
        self._simulator_factory = simulator_factory
        self._user_requests = user_requests
        self._config = config or TrainingConfig()
        self._env_config = env_config or EnvConfig()
        self._reward_config = reward_config or RewardConfig()
        self._simulator_config = simulator_config or SimulatorConfig()
        self._tokenizer = tokenizer
        self._tensorboard_log = Path(tensorboard_log)
        self._checkpoint_dir = Path(checkpoint_dir)
        self._training_log_dir = Path(training_log_dir)
        self._reward_predictor = reward_predictor
        self._reward_predictor_fit_every = reward_predictor_fit_every

        self._ppo: PPO | None = None
        self._device = self._resolve_device(self._config.device)
        log.info("trainer.device", device=self._device)

    @staticmethod
    def _resolve_device(device_cfg: str) -> str:
        """Resolve 'auto' to 'cuda' or 'cpu' based on availability."""
        if device_cfg == "auto":
            return "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
        return device_cfg

    # ── Public interface ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def train(self, num_timesteps: int | None = None) -> None:
        """
        Run PPO training for ``num_timesteps`` environment steps.

        If ``config.resume_from`` is set, the SB3 model is loaded from that
        checkpoint before continuing. Compressor weights are loaded separately
        via ``load_checkpoint()``.

        Parameters
        ----------
        num_timesteps : Override for the number of training steps.
                        Defaults to ``config.num_timesteps``.
        """
        n_steps = num_timesteps or self._config.num_timesteps

        # Create a timestamped run directory for training-only JSONL artifacts.
        # Each train() call gets its own directory so runs don't overwrite each other.
        run_id = datetime.now(tz=timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
        run_logger = RLRunLogger(run_id=run_id, training_dir=self._training_log_dir)

        # Save manifest immediately so post-processing tools can find this run.
        run_dir = self._training_log_dir / run_id
        manifest = TrainingRunManifest.create(
            run_id=run_id,
            compressor_type=type(self._compressor).__name__,
            n_train_requests=len(self._user_requests),
            checkpoint_dir=self._checkpoint_dir,
            run_name=getattr(self._config, "run_name", "") or "",
            reward_weights=self._reward_config.weights.model_dump(),
            ppo_hyperparams=self._config.ppo.model_dump(),
            n_envs=self._config.n_envs,
            num_timesteps=n_steps,
            extra={"device": self._device},
        )
        save_manifest(manifest, run_dir)
        log.info("trainer.manifest.saved", run_id=run_id, path=str(run_dir / "manifest.json"))

        # Build vectorised env (with WorldPool if configured)
        vec_env = self._make_vec_env()

        # Build or restore PPO model and move to device
        if self._config.resume_from:
            self._ppo = self._load_ppo(self._config.resume_from, vec_env)
        else:
            self._ppo = self._build_ppo(vec_env)

        # Explicitly move the compressor to the training device.
        # SB3 moves standard policy layers (token_embed, value_net) automatically,
        # but the compressor's HF model is a nested object that needs explicit placement.
        try:
            self._compressor.to(self._device)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        except AttributeError:
            pass  # non-HF compressors (IdentityCompressor) may not expose .to()

        # Build callbacks
        callbacks = self._build_callbacks(run_logger=run_logger)

        # Run training
        try:
            self._ppo.learn(
                total_timesteps=n_steps,
                callback=callbacks,
                reset_num_timesteps=not bool(self._config.resume_from),
            )
        finally:
            run_logger.close()

    def save_checkpoint(self, path: str | Path | None = None) -> None:
        """
        Save SB3 PPO model + compressor weights.

        Parameters
        ----------
        path : Directory to save into. Defaults to ``checkpoint_dir/final``.
        """
        if self._ppo is None:
            raise RuntimeError("No trained model to save. Call train() first.")

        save_dir = Path(path) if path else self._checkpoint_dir / "final"
        save_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        # SB3 saves policy + optimizer state into a single zip
        ppo_path = save_dir / "ppo_model"
        self._ppo.save(str(ppo_path))

        # Compressor weights (HF format or custom)
        compressor_path = save_dir / "compressor"
        compressor_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._compressor.save_checkpoint(str(compressor_path))

    def load_checkpoint(self, path: str | Path) -> None:
        """
        Load compressor weights from a checkpoint directory.

        Note: To resume SB3 PPO training state (optimizer, step count), call
        ``train()`` with ``config.resume_from`` set. This method only restores
        the compressor model weights.

        Parameters
        ----------
        path : Directory containing the ``compressor/`` sub-directory.
        """
        compressor_path = Path(path) / "compressor"
        if not compressor_path.exists():
            # Allow passing the compressor directory directly
            compressor_path = Path(path)
        self._compressor.load_checkpoint(str(compressor_path))

    # ── Private helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _make_vec_env(self) -> VecEnv:
        """
        Create a vectorised ``CompressionEnv`` using SB3's ``make_vec_env``.

        Uses WorldPool when ``simulator_config.unique_per_episode=False`` (default)
        to avoid regenerating a world on every reset.  Falls back to the raw
        simulator_factory when unique_per_episode=True.

        Each parallel environment gets its own ReActAgent on every reset(),
        so there is no shared policy state across workers.
        """
        reward_fn = RewardFunction(config=self._reward_config)
        env_config = self._env_config
        tokenizer = self._tokenizer
        agent_factory = self._agent_factory
        user_requests = self._user_requests

        # Choose simulator source: pool or fresh-per-episode
        if self._simulator_config.unique_per_episode:
            effective_factory = self._simulator_factory
        else:
            pool = WorldPool(
                simulator_factory=self._simulator_factory,
                pool_size=self._simulator_config.pool_size,
                seed_range=tuple(self._simulator_config.seed_range),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                rng_seed=getattr(self._config, "seed", 42),
            )
            pool.build()
            log.info("world_pool.ready", pool_size=len(pool))
            effective_factory = pool.sample

        def env_factory() -> CompressionEnv:
            return CompressionEnv(
                agent_factory=agent_factory,
                simulator_factory=effective_factory,
                reward_fn=reward_fn,
                user_requests=user_requests,
                config=env_config,
                tokenizer=tokenizer,
            )

        vec_env = make_vec_env(
            env_factory,
            n_envs=self._config.n_envs,
            seed=getattr(self._config, "seed", None),
        )
        return vec_env

    @staticmethod
    def _make_lr_schedule(base_lr: float, schedule: str, num_timesteps: int) -> Any:
        """
        Build an SB3-compatible learning rate schedule callable.

        Parameters
        ----------
        base_lr        : Starting learning rate.
        schedule       : 'constant' | 'linear' | 'cosine'
        num_timesteps  : Total training steps (used for decay schedules).

        Returns
        -------
        Callable(progress_remaining: float) → float
            SB3 passes ``progress_remaining`` which goes from 1.0 → 0.0.
        """
        import math as _math

        if schedule == "linear":
            def lr_fn(progress_remaining: float) -> float:
                # Decays from base_lr to base_lr/10 as progress goes 1.0 → 0.0
                return base_lr * (0.1 + 0.9 * progress_remaining)
            return lr_fn

        if schedule == "cosine":
            def lr_fn(progress_remaining: float) -> float:
                # Cosine annealing from base_lr to base_lr/10
                cos_val = (1.0 + _math.cos(_math.pi * (1.0 - progress_remaining))) / 2.0
                return base_lr * (0.1 + 0.9 * cos_val)
            return lr_fn

        # Default: constant
        return base_lr

    def _build_ppo(self, vec_env: VecEnv) -> PPO:
        """
        Instantiate SB3 PPO with ``CompressorPolicy``.

        ``policy_kwargs`` are forwarded to ``CompressorPolicy.__init__()``
        as additional keyword arguments beyond what SB3 injects automatically
        (observation_space, action_space, lr_schedule).
        """
        hp: PPOHyperparams = self._config.ppo

        lr_schedule = self._make_lr_schedule(
            base_lr=hp.learning_rate,
            schedule=getattr(hp, "lr_schedule", "constant"),
            num_timesteps=self._config.num_timesteps,
        )

        policy_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {
            "compressor": self._compressor,
            "value_hidden_dim": 256,
        }

        ppo = PPO(
            policy=CompressorPolicy,
            env=vec_env,
            learning_rate=lr_schedule,
            n_steps=hp.n_steps,
            batch_size=hp.batch_size,
            n_epochs=hp.n_epochs,
            gamma=hp.gamma,
            gae_lambda=hp.gae_lambda,
            clip_range=hp.clip_epsilon,
            ent_coef=hp.ent_coef,
            vf_coef=hp.vf_coef,
            max_grad_norm=hp.max_grad_norm,
            tensorboard_log=str(self._tensorboard_log),
            policy_kwargs=policy_kwargs,
            device=self._device,
            verbose=1,
        )
        return ppo

    def _load_ppo(self, checkpoint_path: str | Path, vec_env: VecEnv) -> PPO:
        """
        Load SB3 PPO from a checkpoint zip and set the new vec_env.

        The compressor weights inside the policy are NOT automatically restored
        by SB3 — ``load_checkpoint()`` must be called separately.
        """
        ppo_zip = Path(checkpoint_path) / "ppo_model.zip"
        if not ppo_zip.exists():
            ppo_zip = Path(checkpoint_path)  # allow passing the zip directly

        policy_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {
            "compressor": self._compressor,
            "value_hidden_dim": 256,
        }

        ppo = PPO.load(
            str(ppo_zip),
            env=vec_env,
            policy_kwargs=policy_kwargs,
        )
        return ppo

    def _build_callbacks(self, run_logger: "RLRunLogger") -> CallbackList:
        """
        Build the list of SB3 callbacks used during ``ppo.learn()``.

        Includes:
        - SB3 built-in ``CheckpointCallback`` — saves full PPO model as zip.
        - ``CompressorCheckpointCallback`` — saves only the compressor weights.
        - ``EpisodeLogCallback`` — reward components, episode stats → TensorBoard + JSONL.
        - ``PPOUpdateMetricsCallback`` — per-update PPO diagnostics → TensorBoard + JSONL.
        - ``MCTSMetricsCallback`` — MCTS tree stats → TensorBoard (no-op for non-MCTS runs).

        Parameters
        ----------
        run_logger : Active ``RLRunLogger`` for this training run.
        """
        self._checkpoint_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._tensorboard_log.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        checkpoint_every = getattr(self._config, "checkpoint_every_n_steps", 10_000)

        sb3_ckpt = CheckpointCallback(
            save_freq=checkpoint_every,
            save_path=str(self._checkpoint_dir),
            name_prefix="ppo_compressor",
            verbose=1,
        )

        compressor_ckpt = CompressorCheckpointCallback(
            compressor=self._compressor,
            save_dir=self._checkpoint_dir,
            save_every_n_steps=checkpoint_every,
            verbose=1,
        )

        episode_log_cb = EpisodeLogCallback(
            run_logger=run_logger,
            episode_save_freq=getattr(self._config, "episode_save_freq", 0),
            episodes_dir=Path(self._tensorboard_log).parent / "episodes",
            verbose=0,
        )
        ppo_metrics_cb = PPOUpdateMetricsCallback(run_logger=run_logger, verbose=0)
        mcts_metrics = MCTSMetricsCallback(verbose=0)  # no-op for non-MCTS runs

        callbacks: list[BaseCallback] = [
            sb3_ckpt,
            compressor_ckpt,
            episode_log_cb,
            ppo_metrics_cb,
            mcts_metrics,
        ]

        if self._reward_predictor is not None:
            rp_cb = RewardPredictorCallback(
                reward_predictor=self._reward_predictor,
                fit_every_n_episodes=self._reward_predictor_fit_every,
                verbose=1,
            )
            callbacks.append(rp_cb)

        return CallbackList(callbacks)

1	"""
2	compressor/mcts_gat_distiller.py
3	=================================
4	MCTSGraphAttentionDistiller (TGAD) — Design 2: MCTS-aware trainable compressor.
5	
6	Design: Tree-conditioned distillation via path-set attention
7	------------------------------------------------------------
8	The current ``LLMMCTSCompressor`` distils the MCTS tree by dumping path texts
9	into an LLM prompt. This has three problems:
10	
11	  1. Token economy: distillation consumes the same rate-limited model budget
12	     as the planner.
13	  2. Untrainability: the LLM is frozen; no RL signal shapes its selection policy.
14	  3. Verified/speculative blindness: the LLM cannot distinguish real tool
15	     observations from synthetic MCTS expansion steps (observation=None).
16	
17	TGAD replaces the LLM distillation call with a neural pipeline:
18	
19	    1. Materialise paths from MCTSTreeRepresentation (best + alt paths).
20	    2. Encode each path via FROZEN T5 encoder (mean-pool → [H]).
21	    3. Project structural features [q_value, is_verified, is_best_path, ...]
22	       → [64] via small MLP and concatenate with path embedding.
23	    4. Run 2-layer PathSetEncoder (from ``tree_gat.py``) over N path nodes.
24	    5. Score each path with Linear → sigmoid (Importance Scorer).
25	       Apply Gumbel-softmax top-K during training (differentiable);
26	       hard top-K during inference.
27	    6. Attention-weighted pool selected paths → single context vector [H].
28	    7. T5 decoder + LoRA generates all 6 template sections + top_candidates
29	       and tradeoffs from this context.
30	
31	Key innovations
32	---------------
33	  - Verified/speculative distinction is explicit: ``is_verified`` is a
34	    binary feature computed from whether a path's steps have real observations.
35	    The PathSetEncoder learns to down-weight speculative branches.
36	  - Zero LLM calls at distillation: fully neural, ~10 ms on T4.
37	  - During training: num_simulations can be reduced to 10 (vs. eval-time 50)
38	    because the trained distiller extracts richer signal per simulation.
39	
40	RL training curriculum (recommended)
41	--------------------------------------
42	  Phase 1 — Supervised pre-training (~1 hr, no PPO):
43	    Run LLMMCTSCompressor on 200 episodes offline to generate
44	    (MCTSTreeRepresentation, CompressedState) pairs. Train TGAD via cross-
45	    entropy on CompressedState token sequences. Warms up GAT + decoder.
46	
47	  Phase 2 — PPO fine-tuning (~4 hr, reduced MCTS):
48	    PPO with num_simulations=10, ppo_colab.yaml settings.
49	
50	Fallback (no MCTS)
51	------------------
52	``compress()`` is implemented as a fallback: when no MCTSTreeRepresentation
53	is available, the best-path trajectory is treated as the single "path node"
54	and the rest of the pipeline runs identically. This enables ablation studies
55	without changing the agent mode or config.
56	
57	Memory (Colab T4)
58	-----------------
59	  T5-small encoder frozen (fp16): ~80 MB
60	  T5-small decoder + LoRA (fp16/fp32): ~86 MB
61	  GAT (PathSetEncoder, fp32): ~3 MB
62	  Feature projector + importance scorer (fp32): ~0.5 MB
63	  Adam optimizer state: ~18 MB
64	  Training activations: ~250 MB
65	  ──────────────────────────────────────────
66	  Total: ~437 MB — well within T4's 16 GB.
67	"""

116	class StructuralFeatureProjector(nn.Module):
117	    """
118	    Projects per-path scalar features → [proj_dim] and concatenates with
119	    the path text embedding to form a unified node feature vector.
120	
121	    Input features (5 scalars per path):
122	      0 — q_value        : MCTS Q-value (float, [0, 1])
123	      1 — is_verified    : 1 if path has only real observations, 0 if any synthetic
124	      2 — is_best_path   : 1 for the best-path node, 0 for alternatives
125	      3 — norm_path_idx  : normalised path index (0 = best, 1/(N-1) … = alts)
126	      4 — has_bookings   : 1 if path trajectory contains a booking action
127	    """
128	
129	    def __init__(self, text_dim: int = 512, struct_dim: int = 5, proj_dim: int = 64) -> None:
130	        super().__init__()
131	        self._mlp = nn.Sequential(
132	            nn.Linear(struct_dim, proj_dim),
133	            nn.ReLU(),
134	            nn.Linear(proj_dim, proj_dim),
135	        )
136	        self._fuse = nn.Sequential(
137	            nn.Linear(text_dim + proj_dim, text_dim),
138	            nn.LayerNorm(text_dim),
139	        )
140	
141	    def forward(
142	        self,
143	        text_embs: torch.Tensor,        # [N, text_dim]
144	        struct_feats: torch.Tensor,     # [N, struct_dim]
145	    ) -> torch.Tensor:                  # [N, text_dim]
146	        struct_proj = self._mlp(struct_feats)                    # [N, proj_dim]
147	        combined = torch.cat([text_embs, struct_proj], dim=-1)   # [N, text_dim + proj_dim]
148	        return self._fuse(combined)                              # [N, text_dim]

151	class GumbelTopK(nn.Module):
152	    """
153	    Differentiable top-K selection via Gumbel-softmax.
154	
155	    During training (training=True): uses Gumbel-softmax to produce soft
156	    selection weights. Gradients flow through the selection to the importance
157	    scorer and the GAT.
158	
159	    During inference (training=False): uses hard top-K (argmax) for deterministic
160	    selection.
161	
162	    Why Gumbel-softmax?
163	    -------------------
164	    Standard top-K is non-differentiable (argmax). Gumbel-softmax approximates
165	    the categorical distribution with a continuous relaxation controlled by
166	    temperature τ. As τ → 0 the distribution sharpens to a one-hot.
167	
168	    With τ=1.0 during training, the model receives gradient signal for all
169	    paths proportionally to their importance scores, enabling the importance
170	    scorer to learn from RL reward.
171	    """
172	
173	    def __init__(self, k: int = 3) -> None:
174	        super().__init__()
175	        self._k = k
176	
177	    def forward(
178	        self,
179	        importance_logits: torch.Tensor,   # [N]
180	        node_embs: torch.Tensor,           # [N, H]
181	    ) -> torch.Tensor:                     # [H] — weighted pooled output
182	        """
183	        Returns an attention-weighted pool of the top-K selected nodes.
184	
185	        During training: soft weights via Gumbel-softmax → differentiable.
186	        During inference: hard top-K weights (0/1) → deterministic.
187	        """
188	        N = importance_logits.size(0)
189	        k = min(self._k, N)
190	
191	        if self.training:
192	            # Gumbel-softmax: add Gumbel noise and take softmax
193	            tau = _GUMBEL_TAU_TRAIN
194	            gumbel_noise = -torch.log(
195	                -torch.log(torch.rand_like(importance_logits) + 1e-10) + 1e-10
196	            )
197	            perturbed = (importance_logits + gumbel_noise) / tau
198	            weights = F.softmax(perturbed, dim=0)              # [N] — soft selection
199	        else:
200	            # Hard top-K during inference
201	            tau = _GUMBEL_TAU_EVAL
202	            topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(importance_logits, k)
203	            weights = torch.zeros(N, device=importance_logits.device)
204	            weights[topk_idx] = F.softmax(topk_vals / tau, dim=0)
205	
206	        # Attention-weighted pool → [H]
207	        return (weights.unsqueeze(-1) * node_embs).sum(dim=0)

210	class MCTSGraphAttentionDistiller(TrainableCompressorBase, MCTSAwareCompressor):
211	    """
212	    Tree-conditioned distiller using path-set attention over MCTS search paths.
213	
214	    Replaces LLM-based tree distillation (LLMMCTSCompressor) with a trainable
215	    neural network that explicitly models verified vs. speculative branches and
216	    cross-path relationships.
217	
218	    MRO: MCTSGraphAttentionDistiller → TrainableCompressorBase → MCTSAwareCompressor
219	         → CompressorBase. Python cooperative inheritance handles this cleanly.
220	
221	    Parameters
222	    ----------
223	    model_name_or_path : HuggingFace T5 model ID (default: google/flan-t5-small).
224	    max_path_tokens    : Max tokens per path's trajectory text for encoding.
225	    max_output_tokens  : Max tokens in generated compressed state.
226	    device             : 'cpu' | 'cuda' | 'auto'.
227	    use_lora           : Apply LoRA to the T5 decoder (encoder stays frozen).
228	    lora_config        : LoRA hyperparameters.
229	    top_k_paths        : Number of paths selected by Gumbel top-K.
230	    """
231	
232	    _METHOD = "mcts_gat"
233	
234	    def __init__(
235	        self,
236	        model_name_or_path: str = "google/flan-t5-small",
237	        max_path_tokens: int = _MAX_PATH_TOKENS,
238	        max_output_tokens: int = 512,
239	        device: str = "auto",
240	        use_lora: bool = True,
241	        lora_config: LoRAConfig | None = None,
242	        top_k_paths: int = 3,
243	    ) -> None:
244	        self._model_name = model_name_or_path
245	        self._max_path_tokens = max_path_tokens
246	        self._max_output_tokens = max_output_tokens
247	        self._device = self._resolve_device(device)
248	        self._template = CompressedStateTemplate()
249	        self._top_k_paths = top_k_paths
250	
251	        self._tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_name_or_path)
252	        self._model: PreTrainedModel = AutoModelForSeq2SeqLM.from_pretrained(
253	            model_name_or_path
254	        ).to(self._device)
255	
256	        hidden_dim = self._model.config.d_model   # 512 for T5-small
257	
258	        # Freeze the encoder entirely (Design 2: encoder runs N times per node,
259	        # LoRA on encoder would multiply cost N-fold with no benefit here).
260	        for param in self._model.encoder.parameters():
261	            param.requires_grad_(False)
262	
263	        # Trainable modules ---------------------------------------------------
264	
265	        self._struct_projector = StructuralFeatureProjector(
266	            text_dim=hidden_dim,
267	            struct_dim=_STRUCT_FEATURE_DIM,
268	            proj_dim=64,
269	        ).to(self._device)
270	
271	        # PathSetEncoder (from tree_gat.py): 2-layer multi-head path attention
272	        self._path_encoder = PathSetEncoder(
273	            dim=hidden_dim, num_heads=4, dropout=0.1
274	        ).to(self._device)
275	
276	        # Importance scorer → Gumbel top-K selection
277	        self._importance_scorer = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, 1).to(self._device)
278	        self._gumbel_topk = GumbelTopK(k=top_k_paths)
279	
280	        # Projection that packages [tree_context | best_path_emb] for decoder
281	        self._context_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, bias=False).to(self._device)
282	
283	        # Apply LoRA to decoder attention layers only
284	        if use_lora:
285	            _cfg = lora_config or LoRAConfig()
286	            self._apply_decoder_lora(_cfg)

290	    def compress_with_tree(
291	        self,
292	        tree_repr: "MCTSTreeRepresentation",
293	        previous_state: CompressedState | None = None,
294	    ) -> CompressedState:
295	        """
296	        Distil an MCTS search tree into a structured CompressedState.
297	
298	        Does NOT make any LLM calls — fully neural, ~80 ms on T4.
299	
300	        Pipeline:
301	          1. Materialise N paths from tree_repr
302	          2. Encode each path via frozen T5 encoder
303	          3. Build structural feature vectors (Q-value, verified flag, etc.)
304	          4. Fuse text + structural features via StructuralFeatureProjector
305	          5. Run 2-layer PathSetEncoder (cross-path attention)
306	          6. Score nodes → Gumbel top-K selection → attention pool → context
307	          7. T5 decoder generates full template + top_candidates + tradeoffs
308	        """
309	        nodes = self._materialise_nodes(tree_repr)
310	        path_embs, struct_feats = self._encode_nodes(nodes)
311	        node_feats = self._struct_projector(path_embs, struct_feats)
312	        refined_feats = self._path_encoder(node_feats, n_nodes=len(nodes))
313	        importance_logits = self._importance_scorer(refined_feats).squeeze(-1)  # [N]
314	        tree_context = self._gumbel_topk(importance_logits, refined_feats)      # [H]
315	
316	        # Best-path embedding (index 0 by convention from _materialise_nodes)
317	        best_path_emb = refined_feats[0]                                        # [H]
318	
319	        encoder_out = self._pack_encoder_output(tree_context, best_path_emb)   # [1, 2, H]
320	
321	        prefix_ids = self._get_generation_prefix_ids()
322	        with torch.no_grad():
323	            output_ids = self._model.generate(
324	                encoder_outputs=BaseModelOutput(last_hidden_state=encoder_out),
325	                decoder_input_ids=prefix_ids,
326	                max_new_tokens=self._max_output_tokens,
327	                num_beams=4,
328	                early_stopping=True,
329	                no_repeat_ngram_size=3,
330	            )
331	
332	        generated_text = self._tokenizer.decode(output_ids[0], skip_special_tokens=True)
333	
334	        # Recover top_candidates and tradeoffs from tree_repr for the output state
335	        top_candidates = (
336	            list(tree_repr.top_candidates[:_MAX_ALT_PATHS])
337	            if tree_repr.top_candidates else None
338	        )
339	        tradeoffs = tree_repr.tradeoffs if tree_repr.tradeoffs else None
340	
341	        return self._parse_or_fallback(
342	            generated_text,
343	            trajectory_id=tree_repr.best_path_trajectory.trajectory_id,
344	            step_index=tree_repr.best_path_trajectory.total_steps,
345	            previous_state=previous_state,
346	            top_candidates=top_candidates,
347	            tradeoffs=tradeoffs,
348	        )

403	    def get_log_probs(
404	        self,
405	        trajectory_text: str,
406	        compressed_text: str,
407	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
408	        """
409	        Compute per-token log p(compressed_token | path_context).
410	
411	        Uses the fallback path (single trajectory as path node) since
412	        ``get_log_probs`` receives only a flat trajectory text string,
413	        not the full MCTSTreeRepresentation. This is consistent with how
414	        the PPO rollout buffer stores transitions.
415	
416	        The Phase 1 supervised pre-training uses a different loss (cross-entropy
417	        on tree-conditioned outputs) computed outside of this method.
418	        """
419	        path_emb = self._encode_path_text(trajectory_text).unsqueeze(0)  # [1, H]
420	        struct_feats = torch.tensor(
421	            [[1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0]],
422	            dtype=torch.float32,
423	            device=self._device,
424	        )
425	        node_feats = self._struct_projector(path_emb, struct_feats)
426	        refined = self._path_encoder(node_feats, n_nodes=1)
427	        importance_logits = self._importance_scorer(refined).squeeze(-1)
428	        tree_context = self._gumbel_topk(importance_logits, refined)
429	        best_path_emb = refined[0]
430	
431	        encoder_out = self._pack_encoder_output(tree_context, best_path_emb)  # [1, 2, H]
432	
433	        target_ids = self._tokenizer.encode(
434	            compressed_text,
435	            return_tensors="pt",
436	            max_length=self._max_output_tokens,
437	            truncation=True,
438	        ).to(self._device)
439	
440	        bos_id = self._model.config.decoder_start_token_id or 0
441	        bos = torch.tensor([[bos_id]], dtype=torch.long, device=self._device)
442	        decoder_input_ids = torch.cat([bos, target_ids[:, :-1]], dim=1)
443	
444	        outputs = self._model(
445	            encoder_outputs=BaseModelOutput(last_hidden_state=encoder_out),
446	            decoder_input_ids=decoder_input_ids,
447	        )
448	        logits = outputs.logits.squeeze(0)
449	        log_probs = F.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
450	
451	        target = target_ids.squeeze(0)
452	        token_log_probs = log_probs.gather(
453	            dim=-1, index=target.unsqueeze(-1)
454	        ).squeeze(-1)
455	
456	        pad_id = self._tokenizer.pad_token_id or 0
457	        return token_log_probs * (target != pad_id).float()

459	    def get_trainable_parameters(self) -> list[nn.Parameter]:
460	        """
461	        Return trainable parameters:
462	          - LoRA adapters on T5 decoder (encoder is fully frozen)
463	          - StructuralFeatureProjector parameters
464	          - PathSetEncoder (BidirectionalPathGAT) parameters
465	          - Importance scorer
466	          - Root anchor bias (in PathSetEncoder)
467	          - Context projection
468	        """
469	        params: list[nn.Parameter] = []
470	        # Decoder LoRA (or full decoder if LoRA not applied)
471	        params += [p for p in self._model.decoder.parameters() if p.requires_grad]
472	        # Shared head (lm_head) if trainable
473	        if hasattr(self._model, "lm_head"):
474	            params += [p for p in self._model.lm_head.parameters() if p.requires_grad]
475	        # Our custom trainable modules
476	        params += list(self._struct_projector.parameters())
477	        params += list(self._path_encoder.parameters())
478	        params += list(self._importance_scorer.parameters())
479	        params += list(self._context_proj.parameters())
480	        return params

533	    def _materialise_nodes(
534	        self,
535	        tree_repr: "MCTSTreeRepresentation",
536	    ) -> list[dict]:
537	        """
538	        Convert MCTSTreeRepresentation into a list of node dicts.
539	
540	        Node dict keys:
541	          text       : trajectory text for encoding
542	          q_value    : MCTS Q-value (float)
543	          is_verified: True if all steps in path have real observations
544	          is_best    : True for the best-path node
545	          path_idx   : index in the list (0 = best, 1+ = alternatives)
546	        """
547	        nodes: list[dict] = []
548	
549	        # Best path node (always index 0 — PathSetEncoder expects this)
550	        best_traj = tree_repr.best_path_trajectory
551	        nodes.append({
552	            "text": best_traj.to_text()[:1000],       # truncate for encoding
